name: Giri Shimai
source:
Main character is in love from first sight with his sister-in-law who enters the same college. Now the university life full of expectation begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角對進入同一所大學的義姊一見鍾情。充滿期待的大學生活，就此開始。
